caption: A hula hoop is rolled along a sidewalk and let go; it rolls on by itself, wobbles, and falls over.

sa.check: A hula hoop is rolled along a sidewalk and let go.
The hoop is released rather than kept in a hand.
The rolling comes first, then the wobble, then the fall.

pc.expect: After the release nothing touches the hoop: it rolls on, slows, and changes only by slowing.
pc.fail: The hoop gathers speed after being let go; or it is driven along with nothing touching it; or it starts rolling again after it has fallen.

pc.expect: The hoop leans further as it slows and comes down flat onto the sidewalk.
pc.fail: The hoop leans right over and goes on rolling on its edge without falling; or it rights itself and rolls upright again; or it tips upward off the ground.

pc.expect: It stays upright while it is rolling quickly, and the wobble sets in only as it slows.
pc.fail: The hoop topples over while still rolling quickly; or it stands on its edge without moving and stays standing; or its wobble shrinks as it slows.

pc.expect: The hoop stays a rigid ring as it rolls and lands, rattling flat on the pavement.
pc.fail: The hoop bends out of round as it rolls; or it flops like a loop of rope when it falls; or it bounces high off the pavement.

pc.expect: One hoop on one sidewalk keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The hoop vanishes or a second one appears; or it passes through the pavement; or it turns into another object as it falls.

pc.expect: The hoop's colour, the sidewalk and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The hoop changes colour as it rolls; or the paving slabs change pattern between frames; or the scene beside the sidewalk rearranges.
